passages.context: Section 37 was checked with the whole of chapter 16. Basil reuses First Corinthians 12:4-6 to describe diverse gifts, ministries, and operations while preserving one Spirit, Lord, and God, and he ascribes the distribution and operation to the Spirit.
passages.notes: This is doctrinal reception of Paul's text, not a running exegesis of every item in First Corinthians 12:2-11.
